standard_prerequisites: Chow groups and rational equivalence for locally finite sums of cycles, together with the scheme theoretic image of an integral closed subspace under the morphism
The exact sequences relating the Chow groups of a space, an open subspace and the preimage of its complement, and the lifting of cycles from an open subspace to the whole space
The descent of an isomorphism of finite presentation from the generic point of an integral scheme to a nonempty open subspace, and the scheme case of the statement
core_obligations: Decompose a class on the total space into a finite linear combination of classes of pairwise distinct integral closed subspaces, note local finiteness, take the images in the base and verify that these images again form a locally finite family

Reduce to the fibre products over the images and reassemble: if each class restricts to the pullback of a class on the image, then the locally finite sum of those classes pulls back to something rationally equivalent to the original class
Reduce further to an integral base and to the class of a single integral closed subspace dominating the base, so that the dimension of the base is finite and induction on it becomes available
Base case of the induction: if the dimension of the base is smaller than the shift, the relevant Chow group of the total space vanishes and surjectivity is immediate

Induction step: shrink to a nonempty open subspace, lift the class found on the open to the whole base, and use the exact sequence for the complement so that the difference is supported on the preimage of the complement, which has smaller dimension

Finish by shrinking so that the base is a scheme: extend the isomorphism between the generic fibre and the affine space of the given rank from the generic point to a nonempty open subspace, and quote the scheme case
proof_roadmap: Decompose the class, take images in the base and reduce to the fibre products over those images
Reduce to an integral base and to one dominating integral closed subspace, giving finiteness of the dimension
Run the induction on the dimension of the base through an open subspace, a lifted class and the exact sequence of the complement
Extend the fibrewise affine space isomorphism from the generic point to an open subspace and invoke the scheme case
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the surjectivity of pullback for affine bundles at source lines 3947-3955, label lemma-pullback-affine-fibres-surjective, whose proof occupies source lines 3957-4014. The proof is a reduction-plus-induction argument rather than a computation: the class is decomposed into classes of integral closed subspaces whose images in the base are again locally finite, which allows the statement to be checked on the fibre products over those images and then reassembled; this reduces to an integral base carrying the class of a single dominating subspace and makes induction on the dimension of the base available. The induction step shrinks to an open subspace, lifts the resulting class to the whole base, and disposes of the difference through the exact sequence of the complement. Only at the end does the fibrewise hypothesis enter, through the descent of the generic fibre isomorphism to an open subspace. The counted statement records none of these steps.
